voice.tone: Direct, practical, unapologetic. Focused on real problems and straightforward solutions rather than abstract benefits. No hype or superlatives. Willing to be frank about how they differ from competitors.
voice.rhythm: Short to medium clear sentences mixing punchy statements with explanatory ones. Often includes visible reasoning ('so that', 'allowing you to', 'meaning you can'). Frequent lists. Not ornate.
voice.person: Imperative voice ('Send...', 'Keep...') or implicit second person. Sometimes explicit 'we/our' ('our WYSIWYG editor'). When explaining features, third person ('Loops takes...', 'Loops requires...'). Professional rather than personal.
exemplars: One price for marketing, product, and transactional email. No seat fees, no per-send charges, and every feature on every plan.

Transactional emails with Loops simplify your code. With our WYSIWYG editor and API-like payloads, you can design and manage email templates outside of your codebase, ensuring cleaner code and easier template maintenance.

Unlike older SMTP services, Loops requires the body of emails sent via SMTP to be formatted as an API-like payload. This approach allows you to use Loops' powerful email editor to craft your emails and keep email templating outside of your application code.
Loops integrations let you connect Loops to your product and your workflow tools so you can sync contacts, trigger workflows, and send transactional email.
